replication.target_description: Source describes one experiment with a fixed rectangular-bar size, three velocity conditions, and a velocity × switch-point-position interaction. No Experiment 3 or velocity × stimulus-width test is identified.

n.sample_role: Assigned width-interaction analytic sample not established. Seven participants is the source experiment recruitment count, retained only as a candidate context.
n.exclusions: RT analysis excludes responses >1000 ms or <100 ms (16 misses and 146 anticipated responses out of 2100); these trial exclusions do not establish a sample for the absent width-interaction test.

notes: Identity verified internally: title Visual evoked potentials to change in coloration of a moving bar; authors Carolina Murd, Kairi Kreegipuu, Nele Kuldkepp, Aire Raidvee, Maria Tamm, Jüri Allik; DOI 10.3389/fnhum.2014.00019; ORIGINAL RESEARCH article, 24 January 2014. Supplied Frontiers HTML-to-text contains abstract, methods, results, discussion and references, rather than abstract-only excerpts. No supplied PDF; page locators cannot be checked against PDF pagination. Original study not supplied or examined; unassigned original and other unassigned fields are placeholders. The requested Experiment 3 velocity × stimulus-width interaction is not present in this report. Stimulus dimensions are fixed at 1.2 × 2.3°; switch-point position, not stimulus width, is interacted with velocity. Printed F(18,108) = 1.7, p < 0.051 belongs to velocity × switch-point position and is not assigned to width. Seven participants is contextual recruitment, not a verified analytic N for the assigned absent test; no N inferred from df or trial counts. The abstract gives a successful-replication narrative for decreased RT with velocity, not for the requested width interaction; no width-specific success verdict assigned.
